item.title: Label
item.description: Mlem Records is a netlabel and artist collective run by aliens in cyberspace.

item.title: Minecraft
item.description:
Mlem runs a small Minecraft Java Edition survival server. This server is open to all, that includes you! You’re totally free to drop in and do a little gaming. Do send an email to support@mlemrecords.com to get whitelisted.

Please join at the following address:

minecraft.mlemrecords.com:25565

Latest Version
Max 100 players

History

2026

  • March 29th - So Back

Gang got over it and locked in. Spawn is recovering, Life blooms yet again.

item.title: Contact
item.description:
Got a question? Wanna talk to a person? Want to release something?
You can reach us anytime for the following:

  • A quick chat - hi@mlemrecords.com
  • General inquiries - aliens@mlemrecords.com
  • Support - support@mlemrecords.com
  • DJ ZITwerK - puk@mlemrecords.com

Demos

If you’re interested in releasing music and you’re a cool person, we’d love to help out! If you send us files, please send publicly accessible links that we can stream from and a short message about you and your intentions.

item.title: Legal
item.description:
Mlem Records is registered at the “Kamer van Koophandel” as a sole proprietorship located in the Netherlands under registry number 87588277.

Use of this site is subject to this privacy policy. This site does not serve cookies, make use of AI or blockchain technology. All content served is a result of loving human effort ♥.

Licensing

Most Mlem releases are licensed under CC BY-NC or CC BY-NC-SA. In short, that means you can freely download, share and remix Mlem releases. But can’t use them in commercial works by default. Just ask, we’re nice! (●’◡’●)
